[1/2] Per-request response_format (IDEA-0859): accept {type:text|json_object|json_schema} on /v1/chat/completions and /v1/completions, map it to the request's structured-output grammar (settings untouched), refuse unsupported or malformed formats with a 400 invalid_response_format, failing-first tests, README and ADR-131; [2/2] run npm test and the G-001 tune:gate, record the gate, commit

impact_assessment.why: OpenAI clients send response_format for JSON output; the server silently ignored it, so a client asking for JSON got unconstrained text
impact_assessment.benefits: JSON mode and a client-supplied JSON schema work per request without changing saved settings; unsupported formats are refused instead of faked
impact_assessment.risks: contract: the OpenAI routes gain an opt-in response_format mapping and a 400 code; dependency: none (assertJsonSchemaSupported is local); concurrency: none; state: none changed on disk
impact_assessment.mitigation: mapping is opt-in, defaults unchanged; schema limits reuse the existing 12,000-char and compiler checks; failing-first tests; G-001 gate for generation defaults

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Graceful shutdown (IDEA-1024): a small src/drain.js stops accepting connections, closes idle keep-alive sockets, lets an in-flight reply finish up to a bounded timeout, then force-closes and reports whether it drained; main.js uses it on SIGINT/SIGTERM and a second Ctrl+C quits immediately; failing-first unit tests, ADR-133; [2/2] npm test, aikit check, commit (G-001 not applicable: shutdown only, no generation path)

impact_assessment.why: Shutdown currently calls closeAllConnections at once, so Ctrl+C truncates the reply a client is reading and leaves no chance to finish writing state
impact_assessment.benefits: A running reply is allowed to finish before the process exits; idle keep-alive sockets no longer hold shutdown open; a second Ctrl+C still quits immediately
impact_assessment.risks: contract: shutdown timing and one new module; dependency: none; concurrency: the wait loop polls engine.busy with a deadline; state: none (downloads, lock, server receipt handling unchanged)
impact_assessment.mitigation: bounded timeout, injected clock/wait in tests, second-signal escape, existing download cancel and dispose order kept
